name: Courtyard by Marriott Bandung Dago
short_description: Courtyard by Marriott Bandung Dago is a select-service four-star hotel in the leafy Dago area of Bandung, with an outdoor pool, spa and all-day MoMo Cafe dining popular with Jakarta weekenders.
ai_summary: Courtyard by Marriott Bandung Dago is a select-service four-star hotel on Jalan Ir. H. Juanda in the cool, upland Dago district, a short walk from Kartika Sari and a few kilometres from Gedung Sate and the Braga area. Independent reviewers consistently describe it as punching above its four-star billing, praising a smartly lit lobby, spacious and well-maintained rooms (Premier Suites run around 57 sqm) and a genuinely warm, smiling front-of-house team. The breakfast buffet at MoMo Cafe draws the loudest applause, with bloggers calling the spread closer to five-star standard; Bar@Dago handles evening drinks and light bites. Facilities include a round outdoor pool with a separate children's section, a well-equipped 24-hour gym and a full-service spa, which makes the hotel a reliable family and Jakarta-weekender staycation base. It also runs sizeable meetings and event space. Watch-outs are modest but real: the building exterior looks dated next to newer neighbours, some rooms are due a refresh, and add-on services such as laundry and spa treatments are priced on the higher side. Wi-Fi speed and occasional air-conditioning noise draw scattered complaints. With a solid TripAdvisor base (roughly 4 out of 5 across around 349 reviews, ranked near the middle of Bandung's large hotel field), it reads as a dependable, good-value city hotel rather than a destination resort, best suited to travellers who want central Dago access, strong service and a standout breakfast.

faqs.question: Where is Courtyard by Marriott Bandung Dago located?
faqs.answer: The hotel sits at Jl. Ir. H. Juanda No. 33 in the Dago district of Bandung, West Java. It is about a 7 km drive from Husein Sastranegara Airport and roughly 700 metres from Kartika Sari Dago, with Gedung Sate and the Braga area a few kilometres away.

faqs.question: Is the breakfast at Courtyard Bandung Dago good?
faqs.answer: Yes. The breakfast buffet at MoMo Cafe is the most consistently praised feature, with independent reviewers describing the variety and quality as closer to five-star standard than typical four-star fare, spanning local Indonesian dishes and international options served daily.

faqs.question: What facilities does the hotel offer for families?
faqs.answer: Families get a round outdoor pool with a separate, safer children's section, a kids club, and spacious rooms suited to families with children. There is also a 24-hour gym and a full-service spa, plus all-day dining at MoMo Cafe for flexible family meals.

reviews.title: Courtyard by Marriott Bandung Dago, berkelas dan mewah!
reviews.summary: First-hand stay review praising the elegant lobby, spacious Premiere Suite with mountain views and dual-shower bathroom, complete gym, well-designed pool and varied MoMo Cafe breakfast; only knock is the dated exterior.

reviews.title: Review Courtyard by Marriott Bandung Dago
reviews.author: Oni Hoironi
reviews.summary: Blogger calls it four-star pricing with five-star service: super-clean 57 sqm Premier Suite, comprehensive breakfast, live gamelan and West Javanese touches; notes only an adequate pool and paid extras for spa and room service.
